## Checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria from the issue/story are met
- [ ] `make test` passes (backend pytest with coverage, frontend vitest)
- [ ] `make lint` passes (ruff + mypy, eslint + prettier)
- [ ] Manual demo checked (e.g. `make seed`, then the affected flow)
- [ ] Code reviewed by a teammate per our Agile workflow
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed
